xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4827: fix(models): Gemini, Qwen and GLM catalog refresh (dead tier ids, new models, prices)

plan.title: fix(models): Gemini, Qwen and GLM catalog refresh (dead tier ids, new models, prices)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: One provider group of a catalog audit already split into three sibling issues by provider (PAN-4825/4826/4827). The 24 files are the fixed set of catalog tables every model id must appear in, their tests, three docs and the frontend CI test list. The subsystem count is 8 only because each doc file under docs/ and scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt counts as its own subsystem; the code spans src/lib and src/dashboard.

narratives.Problem: PROVIDERS.google.tierModels.haiku names gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview (shut down 2026-05-25), all three PROVIDERS.dashscope tier ids are dead or never existed (qwen3-coder-plus deprecated 2026-10-10, qwen3-max absent from the Singapore list, qwen3-plus never real), and PROVIDERS.zai tiers name the operator-retired glm-4.7/glm-4.7-flash. Claude Code exports these as tier env vars, so subagents on these providers fail. Several prices are wrong or $0 placeholders, glm-5.3 has no cost row, qwen3.8-max's window is wrong, and new models (gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, glm-5.3-flash, glm-5.3-flashx) are missing.
narratives.Proposal: Lowered from .pan/drafts/PAN-4827.md. Per provider, as a serialized chain of small vertical slices over the shared catalog files: retire dead ids through MODEL_DEPRECATIONS and move tiers to live ids; register the new models across providers.ts, settings.ts, capability additions, class, fallback, cost.ts, the omp registry and the Settings catalog; correct prices to the official pages fetched 2026-11-02. Independently, fix the dead ids in the dashboard Settings key-test route (line-neutral) and update docs. Finish with a general test that no provider's tier ids or haikuModel are MODEL_DEPRECATIONS keys.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not change any provider other than google, dashscope and zai; PROVIDERS.nous (qwen/qwen3.6-plus) stays as is
- Do not edit changelog.mdx, docs/prds/, docs/research/ or src/lib/model-research/research-prompt.md
- Do not change parser routing in src/lib/cost-parsers/jsonl-parser.ts or ohmypi-parser.ts (follow-up PAN-4844)
- Do not retire gemini-3-flash-preview or gemini-3.1-pro-preview (no shutdown date on the official page) and do not change their tiers
- Do not touch the operator-retired gemini-2.5-* rows
- Do not remove glm-4.7/glm-4.7-flash from PROVIDERS.zai.models
- Do not backfill FALLBACK_MAP rows for existing ids (gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, glm-5.3, qwen3.7-plus, qwen3.8-flash)
- Do not change qwen3.7-max's context window (unverified)
- Do not raise any entry in scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt and do not add lines to model-capabilities.ts or routes/settings.ts
- Do not add any hardcoded model fallback

autoDecisions.summary: qwen3-max migrates to qwen3.7-max, not qwen3.8-max as the issue suggested
autoDecisions.rationale: Rule 1 (official page wins): Alibaba's 2026-10-10 notice names qwen3.7-max as the replacement for the qwen3-max snapshots, and the bare alias is absent from the Singapore price list. The opus tier still becomes qwen3.8-max as the issue asked.
The issue adds flashx only if the official page lists it; docs.z.ai pricing lists GLM-5.3-FlashX at $0.37/$1.25.

autoDecisions.summary: Z.AI opus tier moves to glm-5.3
autoDecisions.rationale: docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-5.3 calls GLM-5.3 'Z.ai's latest flagship model', which is the issue's condition.
The deprecations page lists no shutdown date for it (only a recommended replacement); the issue retires it only on a listed shutdown.

autoDecisions.summary: Google haiku tier is gemini-3.1-flash-lite, with its 2027-05-07 shutdown in a dated comment
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names it and Google lists it as the preview's replacement; gemini-3.5-flash-lite was the considered alternative.
Official model page (model-studio/qwen3-8-max) states Context Window 1000000.

autoDecisions.summary: Qwen cost rows go into cost.ts under provider 'custom'; parser routing is filed as PAN-4844
autoDecisions.rationale: The pi reconciler maps dashscope to custom, so the rows price pi sessions now; changing jsonl-parser/ohmypi-parser routing would push the plan past 25 files and is a separate behavior change.

autoDecisions.summary: Dashboard settings route dead ids are fixed in this issue with line-neutral edits
autoDecisions.rationale: The Google model test probes gemini-1.5-flash and the DashScope test probes qwen3-max, both dead; these are this issue's providers and the file is at its 1104-line cap, so only in-place edits are allowed.

autoDecisions.summary: src/lib/ohmypi-models.ts registry rows are updated to match the catalog
autoDecisions.rationale: google and dashscope default to the ohmypi harness, so these rows decide what omp can launch and how it prices; the edits are data-only.

autoDecisions.summary: glm-4.7 and glm-4.7-flash stay in PROVIDERS.zai.models
autoDecisions.rationale: tier-table.ts validates tiered-execution ids against provider.models and agents-spawn-tier-fitness.test.ts uses glm-4.7-flash as a retired tier model; the issue only requires the tiers to move.

autoDecisions.summary: The general invariant test covers tierModels and haikuModel only
autoDecisions.rationale: A planning probe shows anthropic.models contains the deprecated claude-sonnet-4-5 (PAN-4826's work), so a models-list assertion would fail for reasons outside this issue.
